title: Compare and Swap
goal: Update an atomic value conditionally using compare_exchange.
hints: In modern Rust, conditional atomic updates use `compare_exchange` which takes current, new value, and two orderings.
`compare_exchange` returns a `Result<i32, i32>` containing either the old value on success or the actual value on failure.
explanation: `compare_exchange` compares the atomic value with an expected value and updates it if equal. It returns a `Result<T, T>` where `Ok` holds the prior value on success and `Err` holds the current value on failure. Calling `is_ok()` converts the `Result` into a `bool`. `compare_and_swap` is deprecated and takes 3 arguments instead of 4, causing `E0061`. `swap` replaces the value unconditionally and takes 2 arguments. `unwrap()` returns an `i32` which fails type check `E0308` because the function returns `bool`. `is_some()` causes `E0599` because `Result` is not an `Option`.
